scripts.start: pnpm --filter @swarmsim/tables build && pnpm --filter @swarmsim/ts build && concurrently -k 'cd swarmsim-coffee && SKIP_YARN_COREPACK_CHECK=1 yarn start' 'pnpm --filter @swarmsim/ts watch'
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @swarmsim/tables build && pnpm --filter @swarmsim/ts build && cd swarmsim-coffee && SKIP_YARN_COREPACK_CHECK=1 yarn build && cp -rp dist ..
scripts.build:docker: pnpm --filter @swarmsim/tables build && pnpm --filter @swarmsim/ts build && cd swarmsim-coffee && SKIP_YARN_COREPACK_CHECK=1 yarn build:docker && cp -rp dist ..
